_meta.description: Generic, widely-cited delta-check percent thresholds for the four chemistry analytes that already have a critical threshold seeded (db/seed/chemistry-catalog.sql). FEAT-025 (ADR-0023). This file proves the seed and the live delta_check_rule table agree -- it does NOT prove the values themselves are clinically correct. Design-partner sign-off is a separate, open item, same status as chemistry-ranges-criticals.json's own.
